name: sampling-params
note: Upstream 25a2c8dcf (Go fc6f777). streamSimple merges Model.samplingParams with options.samplingParams per key (request wins), then Object.assign's the result onto the body LAST, so a sampling key named like a request field (temperature, max_tokens) overrides it. Includes a key present only on the model, a key present only on the request, an overridden key, and a JSON null. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.2; backend flipped to dist (README rule).
